full.description: This is a microscopic histopathology image of a kidney tissue sample stained with H&E. The section displays renal tubules and a glomerulus showing evidence of microvascular injury. Small thrombi are visible within the glomerular capillaries. These findings are characteristic of thrombotic microangiopathy, such as thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (TTP).

random.description: This is a micrograph of a kidney tissue sample showing a glomerulus surrounded by renal tubules. The image displays focal hyalinization and changes consistent with a renal injury or pathology. The structures are stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E), highlighting cellular details and tissue architecture. These findings may be associated with conditions like glomerulosclerosis or an ischemic process.
